help.ruleTrigger: Whether to count absent days or late arrivals. This cannot be changed after the rule is made.
help.ruleFee: Which fine type applies; its own amount is used each time. Only fees of the fine type appear here.
help.ruleClass: For one class, or for the whole school.
help.ruleFreePerPeriod: The first this-many times in a month are not fined; every time after that is. 0 means fined from the very first time.
help.ruleCap: A student's total fine under this rule in one month will not go above this. Leave empty for no limit.
help.ruleMinMinutesLate: Late-arrival rules only: counts only if at least this many minutes late, 0 to 240. If no late minutes are recorded, it always counts.
help.logStudents: One or more students, up to 200 at a time. A separate bill is made for each.
help.logFee: Which fine type; only fees of the fine type appear here.
help.logAmount: If left empty, the fine type's own amount is used. More than zero, up to two decimals.
help.logIncidentDate: When it happened. It cannot be a date after today, and it must be inside the fine type's academic year.
help.logNote: Why the fine; 3 to 280 characters. The bill carries this reason.
help.logNotify: When on, the guardian is told about the fine.
help.waiveMode: Whether to waive everything that is left, or only part of it.
help.waiveAmount: How much, when waiving part. It cannot be more than what is left.
help.waiveReason: Why you are waiving it; 3 to 280 characters.
